assets.prompt:
Edit/reconstruct the supplied three-panel storyboard into ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS EXTRA-WIDE HORIZONTAL PANORAMA of the entire same garden-drain level. Production game-art master, ideally 6144x1152, approximately 5.5:1 aspect ratio. The output MUST be one long continuous side-on orthographic view, NOT a sheet, NOT stacked or side-by-side framed panels. No borders, no gutters, no captions, no text, no route arrows, no numbers. NO PLAYER CHARACTERS. NO camera-border roots or blurred foreground vignette; those will be supplied as a separate screen-space layer. Keep environmental roots attached to the actual rear wall and roof.
Preserve watercolor storybook illustration, fine brown ink, old damp blue-gray brick, warm brown stone, jade moss, natural overhead root network, golden luminous accents, reflective shallow blue water. All playable ledges flat-topped, clear silhouette; rear wall calmer. A micro-world; keep all props at consistent scale. The original three images contain OVERLAPPING WINDOWS of the SAME space and DIFFERENT mechanism states. When unrolling, DEDUPLICATE: exactly ONE bioluminescent bulb, ONE height-changing slanted reflector, ONE linked counterweight cradle, two small operating winches on opposite banks of the SAME device. Never repeat the bulb or mirror as separate machines. Choose the HIGH solved optical state consistently across the whole panorama: mirror high, counterweight low.
LAYOUT over a 76-character-height-wide scene, approximate normalized horizontal positions:
0–23%: entrance from pot connector, initial dry ledges and broken brick warmup platforms above water, root interaction knot near entrance. No garden iron gate, no visible whole pot, no lamps.
24–40%: one locally taller old sluice shaft. Two banks around x28–33% separated by an OPEN DARK WATER GAP, no stone piers or stepping-stones inside this gap. Suspended counterweight cradle at ~30% is lowered close to water in this HIGH state, NOT acting as a bridge. In the middle state it could be raised, but show only one state now. Left winch near 26%, upper right winch near 39%. Vertical guide shaft and small fixed pulleys are parts of the ONE mechanism. Organic glowing bulb with thick bracts hangs from ceiling at x36%, y15%; one light shaft DOWN to a 45-degree backslash reflector centered at x36%, y33%; then horizontal light at y33% travels right through the rest of scene. The bulb and mirror must not be centered in the whole panorama; they are around one third of the width.
40–68%: B section with corrected S-shaped traversal. From the upper crank ledge, route drops down-right to a LOWER LONG WALKWAY at x48–56%, top about y83%. At right end a small intermediary step then a higher right-turn bracket x60%, top y71%; return BACK LEFT on two increasing-height cantilevers, around x57% y64% then x54% y57%; turn RIGHT again to upper shelves around x57% y51%, x61% y51%, continuing to x68%. Upper cantilevers are held from rear wall, NOT massive piers blocking the lower walkway. The clear elevation gap between lower lane and upper exit is over three tiny-character heights. Do not insert an extra direct staircase bypassing the S route. A plain matte rectangular THROUGH-HOLE in an old rear masonry rib around x55% at y33% lets the high golden beam pass straight through; no second mirror or jewel at the aperture.
68–100%: C section, narrow uneven brick-cap jumps, a broad waiting ledge near x79%, a small water-driven horizontal inspection trolley on a short rail at x82%, an old paddle wheel below it, final few staggered short jumps, wide final landing and small outlet near far right. Rail is behind the playable foreground, no walkable bridge across its gap. At x97%, y33%, a SMALL CROPPED tail-root skin patch with pearly scales, most body hidden behind masonry; one almond scale receives the beam. No whole beast. Final platform under it, around y46%, with the existing small outlet.
Ceiling, rear walls, waterline and masonry must join smoothly across the entire width with natural variations; ONE physically continuous passage, no visual seams between A B C. Keep longest traversable route readable, not a continuous flat bridge. Water lies low, clear obstacle silhouettes. Foreground frame roots must be COMPLETELY absent from all canvas edges; no black vignette. No UI or character. This master will be separated into background, terrain, water and interactive props afterward.

assets.prompt:
Create a production transparent SPRITE ATLAS of nine separate interactable props extracted/reconstructed from the reference panorama, same watercolor garden-drain style, straight side-on orthographic view. SQUARE canvas, a STRICT 3 columns by 3 rows grid with exactly one prop in each cell, each contained within its own cell with generous 10 percent transparent margin. No drawn grid, no labels, no numbers, no borders, no text. Real transparent background everywhere between props; no ground or diffuse shadow.
TOP ROW:
cell 1: organic bioluminescent underground bulb, ivory/amber fleshy layers, green-brown bracts OPEN downward, short crown of branching roots. Warm inner core but no long beam, no large halo rectangle, no lantern housing.
cell 2: a small reachable ROOT KNOT / living tendril loop, dull brown-green, for the player to activate the bulb. A compact individual rooted knot, no long cable.
cell 3: the fixed-angle 45-degree BACKSLASH silvered mirror shard on its small triangular old metal carriage, only the movable carrier, no tall guide rails, no light beam.
MIDDLE ROW:
cell 4: small flat rectangular counterweight step / mossy iron cradle, same as reference, with two short hanging lugs. NO ropes or chains extending upwards.
cell 5: a side-view old ratcheting hand WINCH with drum, small crank handle and compact feet; single prop; no attached long cable.
cell 6: stationary SLUICE GUIDE RIG: two tall thin vertical metal guide rails, a small fixed pulley on a lintel above each, muted rusty brass. It is one tall narrow object within its cell; NO mirror, NO cradle, NO ropes, NO plant and NO background wall. Keep guides unobstructed so movable sprites can be added later.
BOTTOM ROW:
cell 7: small horizontal MOVING INSPECTION PLATFORM and its compact undercarriage, mossy stone or wood top, clearly flat standable top. NO rail, no waterwheel, no background support.
cell 8: standalone old WATER PADDLE WHEEL rotor, circular side profile with 8 wooden paddles and central bronze axle. NO stream, no surrounding scaffold, no rail, no platform.
cell 9: small cropped living TAIL-ROOT patch with pearly overlapping ivory scales and one almond-shaped gold feeding scale; organic soft curved edge, not a stone; no body face/limb; no wall or outlet; no incoming beam.
Maintain believable shared material colors, very fine sepia ink outlines, watercolor texture. Distinct complete disconnected silhouettes. Exactly nine props in this precise row-major order, no duplicates. No enormous blocks of transparent outside padding around the whole atlas. Each prop optimally fitted inside its own square cell with clear alpha gutters for independent Unity sprite slicing.
